input: Ilanga latjhinga ngaphasi komkhathizwe, likhanyisa ukukhanya okufuthumeleko emigwaqweni yedorobha ephithizelako. Abantu bebaphuthuma eendleleni, iinyawo zabo zizwakala emgwaqweni njengombana iingcoco zihlangana zaba kukububula. Emakhefini, iphunga lekhofi esanda kuphekwa lihlangana nephunga lezinto ezibhakiweko, limema abantu abadlulako bona bame begodu bazithokozise. Abadlali bemigwaqo bangezelela iingoma nesigqi, okwenza bona idorobha laba yinto ephilako yomsindo nombala. Njengombana kuhlwa, amalambu wedorobha aphazima, akhanyisa umdanso oyinkimbinkimbi wepilo yedorobha ebegade ingakaze ijame kwamambala.

Ngaphetjheya kwendawo ekulu yamagquma namahlathi ahlaza, umoya wawuhleba iimfihlo emakarini. Iinlwana zeganga bezigijima ngaphasi komthungo, ukunyakaza kwazo bekuyibhalethi ethulileko eyenziwa ngaphasi kwelihlo eliqalileko lezulu. Umlambo bewujikeleza kancanikancani endaweni, ingaphezulu lawo litjengisa ukukhanya kwelanga begodu lenza amaphetheni acwebezelako athokozisa amehlo. Iinyoni zavuma iingoma ebezibonakala zilandisa indatjana yephasi lemvelo, ingoma yokuphila ebegade izwakala ekuthuleni. Kilesi simo esithulileko, isikhathi besibonakala sihamba, sivumela iinkhathi zokucabangisisa nokuthula bona zithuthuke.

Ngaphakathi kwelayibhrari ekulu, amatjhelfu bekavuleke khulu, azele iincwadi zezihloko zoke. Iphunga lamaphepha agugileko kanye nokubophelela kwesikhumba lagcwalisa umoya, lamema abahloli belwazi bona bahlole imihlaba eminengi. Abafundi bebahlala eendaweni ezihle begodu ematafuleni amakhulu, amehlo wabo aqala amakhasi njengombana iingqondo zabo zizulazula ngemibono, iindaba, nezinto ezitholweko. Ngezinye iinkhathi, ukurhuwelela kokuvula amakhasi bekuvala ukuduma okuthulileko kokudzimelela. Ngaphandle, umhlaba waragela phambili nokugijima kwawo, kodwana ngaphakathi kwamaboda la, indawo yoke yokuhlakanipha nokucabanga kwakhula ngokuthula okuvumelanako.

Emakethe ephithizelako, abathengisi bamemeza ngeminikelo yabo, bafuna ukutjhejwa hlangana netjhada elikhulu. Iintolo bezizele iinthelo eziphilako, iinongo ezinuka kamnandi, kanye nezindwangu ezimibalabala, into ngayinye ikhuluma indatjana yomsuka nomsebenzi wezandla. Abathengi bathengiselana ngeentengo begodu batjhentjhana ngeendaba, okwenza bona kube nokuthintana kwabantu. Iphunga lenyama eyosiweko namakhekhe amnandi bekuzwakala emoyeni, kulinga abadlulako bona bazithokozise. Phakathi kwesiphithiphithi, bekunesigqi esingaphasi — ukubetha okugcina imakethe iphila begodu iphilile, ubufakazi bomoya ohlala njalo womphakathi.

Elwandle elikhulu, amagagasi atjhayisa isikhumba somkhumbi, athumela ukufafaza kwamanzi anetswayi emoyeni. Isiqhema sakhamba ngenhloso, silungisa amaseyila begodu sikhamba endaweni ekulu eluhlaza okwesibhakabhaka, siqondiswa ziinkwekwezi kanye nokuzwa okunolwazi. Umkhathi wawunwebeka ngokungapheliko, ikhanvasi yemibala etjhugulukako ukusuka ekuseni ukuya ekuseni, iveza ubuhle obungenamkhawulo bephasi. Ama-seagull ajikeleza phezulu, ukukhala kwawo kuzwakala ngaphetjheya kwamanzi, okwengeza ukuzwakala kwemisindo yelwandle. Nanyana ilwandle belilodwa, umuzwa wokuzijabulisa nokuthola kwakhula hlangana nomkhathi ongapheliko.

Enhliziyweni yepaki yedorobha ephithizelako, ukuhleka kwabantwana kwazwakala njengombana badlala emajikeni nama-slide. Imindeni yenza ipikiniki phezu kweengubo ezirhatjheke etjanini, yabelana ngeendaba begodu ithabela ukuba nomunye nomunye ngaphasi komthunzi wemithi emide. Abagijimi nabakhweli bamabhayisikili bebakhamba ngeendlela ezijikajikako, ukunyakaza kwabo kwenza isizinda esizwakalako sokuthula kwemvelo phakathi kwepilo yedorobha. Amadada nama-swan bekatjhelela kuhle phezu kwedamu, okwenza bona kube nokuthula. Njengombana ilanga liphela, iphakhi yatjhuguluka yaba yindawo ethulileko lapho abantu abahlala emadorobheni bathola khona ukuphumula emisebenzini yabo ephithizelako.

Iqophelo lentaba linikela ngombono omangalisako weengodi ezizungezeko kanye neenqonga ezikude. Abakhweli beentaba bebahlangana emililweni emincani, babelana ngeendaba zekhambo labo namabhudango wesikhathi esizako. Umoya bewupholile begodu uvuselela, ugcwalisa amaphaphu nge-oksijini ehlanzekileko, eqabulako. Amabala weqhwa anamathele emathambekeni anamadwala, aphazima ngaphasi kokukhanya kwelanga, aphikisana nephasi elimnyama kanye neentjalo ezincani ngaphasi. Njengombana amafu adlula, amathunzi adlala endaweni, agandelela ubuhle bendawo. Nawujame phezulu ephasini, umuntu uzwa ukuhlobana okukhulu nobukhulu bemvelo obungapheliko.

Endaweni ethulileko yedorobha, imindeni yenza imisebenzi yayo ngesigqi esithambileko. Abantwana bebadlala i-hopscotch eendleleni, ukuhleka kwabo bekuzwakala emoyeni njengombana ababelethi bebabukele ngokutjheja besuka emaveranda aseduze. Iingadi beziqhakaza ngemibala eminengi — amarozi, ama-tulip, ama-daisies — woke aphikisana ngokukhanya kwelanga nokutjhejwa. Iphunga lotshani obusanda kusikwa kanye namathuthumbo aqhakazako kwenza umoya othabisako ohlanganisa ummongo wekhaya. Ukuhlwa kwaletha ukukhanya okuthambileko kwamalambu womgwaqo kanye nomuzwa wokuragela phambili ngokuthula okuvamise ukunganakwa kodwana okuthandwa khulu.

Iindlhadlha zakade bezikhuluma ngeendaba zempucuko ebegade sele iphelile, amaboda wawo wamatje sele aphelile kodwana ahlala isikhathi eside. Imivini ne-moss bezikhukhuleka eendaweni ezivulekileko, okuveza ukukhamba kwesikhathi nokubuyiselwa kwemvelo kwezinto ezenziwe babantu. Abahloli bebazulazula ema-archways namagcekeni, bacabanga ngepilo ebegade iphila ngaphakathi kwezakhiwo lezi. Ukuthula bekukukhulu, kwaphazanyiswa umdumo weenyawo kanye nokubiza kwenyoni. Njengombana ilanga litjhinga ngemva kwamatje, amathunzi aba made, aphosa umoya wemfihlakalo nokuhlonipha phezu kwendawo. Bekusikhumbuzo sokuba khona komlando okuhlala isikhathi eside kanye neendaba ezifakwe kiwo woke amatje.

Esikhumulweni seenqhema seenqhema esiphithizelako, abahambi baphuthuma badlula ngomuzwa wokulindela nokulangazelela. Amasondo wemithwalo bekatjhayela phasi ephasini elipholitjhiweko njengombana iingcoco ngeenlimi ezinengi zizele umoya. Izikrini zedijithali bezikhanyisa isikhathi sokusuka nokufika, zikhokela abagibeli abanganasineke namkha abathabileko ukuya lapho baya khona. Iinkomitjhana zekhofi kanye nama-wrapper wokudla okulula gade kugcwele amanye amakhona, ubufakazi bokudla kwasekuseni okurhabako kanye namalungiselelo womzuzu wokugcina. Phakathi kwesiphithiphithi esihlelekileko, bekunokuzwisisana okwabelwana ngakho — umzuzu wesikhatjhana wokuthintana hlangana nabantu abangabaziko ababotjhwe sifiso esifanako sokuhlola, ukubuya, nofana ukufuna ukuthoma okutjha. Ikhambo belihlala lizokuragela phambili.

Esiqhingini esihle, amagagasi athambileko ahlangana namabhishi anesihlabathi, amema ukuphumula nokuzindla. Imithi yesundu gade itjhinga ngobuvila emmoyeni welwandle, ubujamo bayo buphambene nesibhakabhaka esikhanyako. Abantu abaya elwandle bathamela ilanga, bakha iinqaba zesihlabathi, begodu babuthelela amagobolondo welwandle, benza ubumnandi obulula obufana nepharadesi. Ngaphasi kwamanzi, amadwala wamakhorali aphilako agcwele ukuphila kwelwandle okumibalabala, okubonwa ngamanzi ahlanzekileko aveza umhlaba ofihlekileko wokumangalisa. Njengombana kuhlwa, umkhathi waba mnyama ngemibala ye-orenji nepinki, okutjengisa ukuphela kwelinye ilanga endaweni ethulileko. Ubuhle besihlengele bebunikela indawo ephephileko kude nomdumo wepilo yangamalanga.

Esakhiweni samahhovisi sesimanjemanje, abasebenzi basebenzisana emakamelweni womhlangano anamaboda wengilazi kanye neendawo zokusebenza ezivulekileko. Ukuduma kwamakhomphyutha nokukhala kwamafoni kwenza umsindo ongapheliko wangemuva, ophawulwa kutjhafaza kwamakhibhodi nokuhlanganiswa kwamaphepha. Amagumbi wokuphumula anikela ngezikhathi zokuphumula, nalabo abasebenza nabo babelana ngekofi begodu bacoca ngokungakajayeleki. Amabhodi amhlophe namaskrini atjengisa amatjhadi, isikhathi sephrojekthi, nemibono etjhugulukako, koke kusebenzela imigomo efanako. Nanyana bekunomsebenzi omnengi, bekunomuzwa wenjongo nokusungula okuhlathulula ukulandela ithuthuko nepumelelo yesimanjemanje.

Isitetjhi sesitimela esiphithizelako besisebenza njengendawo yokukhamba, lapho iindaba ezinengi zihlangana khona. Abagibeli baphuthuma ukuthatha iintimela zabo, baphethe iinkhwama namabhafu, omunye nomunye unendawo namabhudango. Abathengisi bathengisa ukudla okulula namaphephandaba eceleni kwamakhawunta wamathikithi azwakala ngamaphimbo neememezelo. Iplatifomu beyithuthumela ngokulindela njengombana iinjini bezirhuwelela, zitjengisa ukusuka nokufika. Kulesi sikhala esifitjhani, isikhathi sokuthintana nokuvalelisa sahlangana, siphindaphinda amazinga wepilo yangelanga ephasini elingapheli ukunyakaza.

Ngaphakathi kwehlathi, ukukhanya kwelanga kwasefa phakathi kwamaqabunga, kwaphosela amaphetheni ahlukileko ephasini elithambileko ngezansi. Iinlwana zazo zoke iinhlobo bezikhamba zithule endaweni yazo, enye nenye idlala indima yayo kuwebhu eyinkimbinkimbi yokuphila. Umoya bewunothile ngephunga le-moss, iphayini, nehlabathi elimanzi, okuvusa umuzwa wokuzinza kwakade. Umlambo omncani bewujikeleza phakathi kwemithi, ukurhuwelela kwawo bekusebenza njengetjhada elithobako eliya ehlane elithulileko. Indawo engcwele engakathintwa yahlala iyibufakazi bokujamelana kwemvelo nobuhle obungapheliko bendawo engakathintwa.

Ikhishi eliphithizelako beligcwele umsebenzi njengombana abapheki bepheka ukudla okunengi khulu. Itjhada elivuthako elivela emapakeni lihlanganiswe nephunga lamakhambi, iinongo, kanye nesinkwa esanda kubhakwa, okwenza indawo ekhangako. Iinthako zaqunywa, zavuselelwa, begodu zafakwa iinongo ngokunembileko, enye nenye ifaka isandla ekuzwaneni kwamafleyiva. Abasebenzi bakhamba ngaphandle komraro hlangana neentetjhini, basebenzisana ukuqinisekisa bona ipuleti ngayinye ifinyelela ekupheleleni. Iimvakatjhi bezilindele ukudla kwazo, ukulindela kwakhula njengombana izinto zokupheka zihlangana — ukudla ngakunye bekungumsebenzi wobukghwari oklanyelwe ukuthabisa imizwa nokwanelisa umphefumulo.

Ngaphakathi kwegalari yobuciko, amaboda bekahlotjiswe ngeqoqo elihlukahlukeneko lemidwebo, imifanekiso, kanye neenthombe. Iimvakatjhi bezikhamba kancanikancani ukusuka esiqetjhaneni ukuya esiqetjhaneni, omunye nomunye wama ukuhlathulula nokuthokozela imibono yabadwebi. Ukukhanyisa kwaveza ubujamo nemininingwana, okwenza bona imisebenzi yobuciko iphile. Iingcoco ezithulileko ngethekhnikhi, imizwa, kanye nencazelo zengeza ukujula kwesipiliyoni. Indawo leyo beyiyindawo yokusungula nokuzindla, lapho amandla wokuvezwa okubonwako akhuthaza imibono etja begodu akhuthaza umcabango.

Ekuseni khulu echibini, inkungu yaphakama kancanikancani ebusweni bamanzi, yakha umoya omnandi. Amadada agwedla ngobuvila, atjhiya amagagasi emva kwawo, lokha ama-dragonflies agijima ngaphezu kwamahlanga. Ukuthula kwekuseni kwaphulwa umdumo omncani weenyoni ezivumako ezamukela ilanga. Imithi eyayizungezile beyibonakala emanzini apholileko, iphinda kabili umuzwa wokuthula. Umzuzu lo wokuthula bewufaka hlangana ubuhle bemvelo ngaphambi kobana umhlaba uvuke ngokupheleleko, usikhumbuza ngesigqi esinokuthula esikhona emjikelezweni wemvelo.

Amalambu wethiyetha aphelelwa mamandla njengombana ikhetheni liphakama, kwaveza isiteji esibekelwe umdlalo ongalibalekiko. Abalingisi bangenela iindima zabo, baveza abalingisi ngethando nokukholwa, benza indaba iphile. Iimlaleli bezithathekile, ukuhleka nokushaya izandla kwaveza izikhathi ezibuhlungu kanye namatjhuguluko amangalisako. Umvumo nokukhanyisa kwathuthukisa imizwa nomoya, kwatjhugulula indawo yaba yindawo yokucabanga nokumangala. Njengombana umnyanya lo uphetha, kwaqhuma izandla, ukugidinga ubuciko nomzamo owenza umdlalo waba yinto ekhumbulekako kibo boke abantu.

Emadolobhaneni athulileko, izindlu bezimi emigqeni ehlelekileko, enye nenye inengadi yayo ezele amathuthumbo nohlaza. Iintrada bezigcwele ubuso obujayelekileko nokuvuma ngehloko okunobungani, okuveza umuzwa womphakathi nokuzinza. Abantwana bebadlala emagcekeni ngesikhathi abantu abadala benza imisebenzi yangekhaya nofana bacoca emaverandeni. Ukuduma okuncani kwepilo yelanga nelanga kwenza isizinda esiduduzako, sigandelela ukuqakatheka kwekhaya nokuthintana. Kwathi nakuhlwa, ukukhanya okuthambileko kwamalambu weveranda kwamukela ubusuku, kwahlala esigqini esinokuthula sepilo yamadorobha.

Indlela yeentaba beyijika phezulu ngeendawo ezinamandla, itjhijilela abakhweli beentaba ngeendawo eziphakemeko kanye namadwala. Igadango ngalinye belitlhoga umzamo nokuzimisela, kwavuzwa yimibono emangalisako esiqongolweni. Umoya opholileko weentaba bewuvuselela imizwa, ngesikhathi amathuthumbo weganga neentjalo eziqinileko zinamathela ematjeni. Ngezinye iinkhathi, ukukhala kwekhozi okukude nofana ukubona imbuzi yeentaba bekukhumbuza abakhambi ngobuhle beganga obubazungezileko. Ukufikelela esicongweni bekumzuzu wokunqoba, ubufakazi bokuphikelela namandla wemvelo amangalisako.

Imakethe edorobheni lakade gade inemisebenzi eminengi, abathengisi bamemeza ngepahla yabo begodu abathengi bathengiselana ngokuthaba. Iintolo bezizele izinto ezenziwe ngezandla, iinongo, kanye nezindwangu, into ngayinye ijamele isiqetjhana samagugu wamasiko anothileko wedorobha. Iphunga lokudla okungakajayeleki lagcwalisa umoya, lilinga abantu abadlulako bona bathathe amafleyiva amatjha. Imidumo yomvumo nomdanso ovela kubadlali abaseduze yengezelela umoya omuhle. Isikhungo esiphithizelako besingasi yindawo yokurhweba kwaphela; bekuyindlela yomlando, amasiko, nokuthintana kwabantu.

Ngaphasi kwesibhakabhaka sasebusuku, umlilo wekhempu waphazima uphosa amathunzi wokugida ebusweni babahambi abadiniweko. Babelana ngeendaba begodu bavuma iingoma, bathabela ithabo elilula lobungani. Umlilo oqhaqhazelako bewunikela ukufuthumala emoyeni opholileko, ngesikhathi iinkwekwezi eziphezulu zinikela ngekhanvasi yezulu yezimangaliso ezingapheliko. Ukubiza kwesikhova okukude nokurhuwelela okuncani kwamahlamvu kwakha isizinda esithobako. Ngalesi sikhathi, sizungezwe yimvelo nabangani, isikhathi besibonakala sijame, sigandelela ukukhanga okungaphelelwa sikhathi kweenkhathi zangaphandle.

Umhlangano wezefundo uhlanganise izazi ezivela ephasini loke ukwabelana ngemibono nokucoca ngezinto ezitjha. Iinkulumo eziqakathekileko zenza iinkulumo ezikhuthazako, zavusa imigqa etja yokubuza nokusebenzisana. Iinkhathi zokuphumula zikhuthaze ukukhulumisana okusebenzisanako, ukukhulisa umphakathi weengqondo ezifuna ukwazi. Ukutjhentjhana ngolwazi kwangezelelwa ziinhlangano zokuthintana nemisebenzi yamasiko, okunothisa isipiliyoni ngaphezu kwezemfundo. Njengombana umhlangano uphetha, abahlanganyeli badlulisela phambili imibono emitjha nokusebenzisana okungenzeka, okukhuthaza ituthuko emikhakheni yabo.

Izulu elincani lawela phezu kwedorobha, lakha impompi enesigqi emafasiteleni nasemaphahleni. Abakhamba ngeenyawo baphuthuma ngaphasi kwezambulela, amagadango wabo bekaphuthuma kodwana angakajahi, njengombana imifanekiso beyiphazima emgwaqweni omanzi. Iphunga lomhlabathi omanzi nezulu elitjha kwavuselela imizwa, kwanikela umzuzwana wokuvuselelwa hlangana nepilo yedorobha. Amalambu wemigwaqo akhanyisa igolide, aphikisana nesibhakabhaka esipholileko esimpunga, angezelela ukufuthumala okuthokomeleko endaweni. Ukuphumula nokuthula kwathatha indawo yokuphithizela kwangaphambilini, njengombana idorobha lamukela ukupholisa kwezulu, likhumbuza woke umuntu ngamandla wemvelo.

Ithempeli lakade beliyifakazelo lobuciko babantu nobumoya, amaboda walo wamatje aphethwe mumoya nobujamo bezulu amakhulu weminyaka. Iinthombe ezibaziweko neenthombe ezihlobisa ubuso bayo, zihleba iindaba zokuzinikela neenganekwane. Abavakatjhi neemvakatjhi ngokufanako bathola iduduzo nokugqugquzeleka ngaphakathi kweendawo zayo ezithulileko, lapho ukuthula nokuhlonipha kwagcwala khona umoya. Ukuba khona kwethempeli kwahlanganisa isikhathi esidlulileko nesikhathi samanje, kwaba sikhumbuzo esicwengileko segugu lamasiko nokufuna okuhlalako kwencazelo. Njengoba ukukhanya kwelanga kusefa ngaphakathi kwemifantu nemifantu, umuzwa wokungaphelelwa sikhathi wagubuzela indawo.

Umnyanya omuhle bewumbukiso onemibala, umdumo, nethabo. Ama-rides ajikeleza begodu aphakama, azele ukurhuwelela kwethabo, lokha iintolo zemidlalo zinikela ngamathuba wemiklomelo nokuhleka. Abadlali abambethe izambatho bathokozisa abantu ngama-acrobatic, amaqhinga womlingo, kanye nezenzo zomvumo, okubamba umcabango wayo yoke iminyaka. Iphunga le-cotton candy, i-popcorn, kanye namasoseji aphekiweko kwadosa ababekhona bona bazithabise. Kwathi nakufika ubusuku, amalambu aphazimako nomvumo kwadala umoya onamandla owagubha ithabo, umphakathi, kanye nobumnandi obulula bepilo.

Ekhoneni elithulileko lomtapo wezincwadi, ideske elilodwa belikhanyiswa lilangabi, limema umfundi bona alahlekelwe yincwadi. Amakhasi la bekanemihlaba yokuzijabulisa, ilwazi, nemizwa, enye nenye beyiyindlela yokuzwisisa okutjha nofana ukubalekela. Ukuthula kwakhuthaza ukugxila nokucabangisisa, indawo yokuphephela esiyaluyalu ngaphandle. Eduze, amashelufu ahlelwe ngesihloko nomtloli anikela ngomfanekiso ocebileko womcabango womuntu nokusungula. Indawo le yokufuna ukwazi itjengisa amandla wokufunda wokukhuthaza, ukufundisa, nokutjhugulula.

Isimu yamadiribe beyinwele ngaphetjheya kwamagquma, imivini yayo gade inamadiribe avuthiweko alungele ukuvunwa. Abasebenzi bebakhamba ngendlela ehlelekileko hlangana nemigqa, bathena begodu baqoqa, omunye nomunye atlhogomela inarha ngokutjheja nangobungcweti. Ilanga lafaka umbala wegolide phezu kwendawo eluhlaza, lagcizelela imibala eluhlaza ehlaza satjani kanye nobubende obujulileko. Umoya bewuzele iphunga elimnandi lezithelo nehlabathi, okutjengisa ummongo wepilo yezokulima. Njengoba isikhathi sokuvuna sitjhidela, kwakhula ukulindela amawayini ebegade asazokwenziwa ngamaqoqo aligugu la.

Idorobha ebegade limbozwe liqhwa beliyindawo ehle khulu ebusika, ngamaphahla ahlanganiswe ngengubo emhlophe begodu nama-ayisi alenga emaphahleni. Iintrada bezithulile, zithuliswe kukuwa okuthambileko kweqhwa, okwenza bona kube nokuthula okunokuthula. Abantwana bakha abantu beqhwa begodu balwa ngebhola leqhwa, ukuhleka kwabo kukhala emoyeni omnandi. Amalambu afuthumeleko avela emakhothejini nasezitolo aphikisana kuhle nendawo ebandako, okwenza bona kube nomuzwa wokuthokoza. Indawo yoke beyibonakala ikhazimula ngomlingo wesizini, imema woke umuntu bona amukele ukuthula kwesikhathi sebusika.

Edorobheni letheku eliphithizelako, imikhumbi yemithwalo neenkepe zokudoba beziphaphatheka ethekwini, iinsika zazo zifikelela phezulu. Abasebenzi bedokodo bakhamba msinyana, balayisha begodu bethula ipahla eyakhuthaza umnotho wedorobha begodu iwuhlanganisa nephasi loke. Iintolo zemakethe eziseduze ne-quay zinikela ngeenhlambi ezitjha, imisebenzi yezandla, kanye neenkhumbuzo zabahambi nabantu bendawo ngokufanako. Iphunga lamanzi anetshwayi, ukudla kwaselwandle, kanye nedizili kuhlanganiswe emoyeni, okutjengisa ukuphila kwepilo yelwandle. Njengoba imikhumbi isuka, idorobha belikhula ngokuhamba, ukurhwebelana, nokudosa okuhlala njalo kwelwandle.

Ubukghwari bokubhaga bugcwalisa indawo yokubhaka ngephunga elifuthumeleko, elimemako elabiza abantu abadlulako bona bangene ngaphakathi. Iinkwa ezisanda kubhakwa kanye namakhekhe bezihlelwe ngobukghwari eendaweni zokubonisa, amaqhwa wazo wegolide kanye namalayini abuthakathaka alinga imizwa. Ababhaki bebabaza njengombana bebaduba ihlama begodu benza amaloroti, ikghono labo libonakala kiyo yoke imininingwana. Amakhasimende athokozele ubujamo obumnandi, athabela ukudla okunekhofi nofana itiye, abelana ngeengcoco phezu kokudla okumnandi okubhakiweko. Ubuciko bokupheka lobu abugcini ngokondla kodwana bubuye buhlanganise abantu ngesiko, ukusungula, kanye nethabo elilula lokudla okuhle.

Phakathi kwe-workshop ephithizelako, abasebenzi bezandla basebenza ngokuzikhandla emaphrojekthini wabo, isiqetjhana ngasinye sitjengisa ikghono nethando. Iinsetjenziswa bezisukela eengodweni nensimbi ukuya etjhilani nebumba, begodu abasebenza ngezandla batjhugulula izinto ezingakalungiswa zibe buciko obusebenzako. Imidumo yamasaha, iisando, kanye nama-loom yahlangana yaba yi-symphony yokudala. Iimvakatjhi bezithokozela ubuciko, kanengi zikhuthazwa bona zenze imisebenzi yazo yobuciko. Umhlangano lo bewubufakazi bobuhlakani babantu nokukhanga okuhlalako kwezinto ezenziwe ngezandla, ezizwakalako.

Ngesikhathi somnyanya othabisako, iinthambo ezihlotjhwe ngamathuthumbo namalangabi bezihamba emigwaqweni, zigidinga amagugu wamasiko nomoya womphakathi. Abadlali abagqoke izambatho badansa begodu badlala umvumo, bathinta ababukeli beminyaka yoke. Iintolo zokudla bezinikela ngezinto ezimnandi zesintu, zabelana ngamafleyiva avela eenzukulwaneni ezidlulileko. Umoya bewuzwakala ngethabo, ukuhleka, kanye nethabo elihlangeneko lokubamba iqhaza. Kwathi nakufika ubusuku, iinqhema zomlilo zakhanyisa isibhakabhaka, zatshwaya umvuthwandaba womcimbi ophilako, ongakhohlwako ohlanganise abantu ndawonye ukugidinga.

Indawo yasemaphandleni ethulileko gade inamasimu namahlathi, lapho isikhathi besibonakala sihamba khona. Abalimi bebatlhogomela iintjalo nemfuyo, imikghwa yabo beyisekelwe emasikweni weminyaka eminengi. Imizana emincani ehlezi hlangana neentjalo eziluhlaza, enamakhotheji atjengisa ubuhle bendawo. Itjhada elimnandi lemvelo — iinyoni ezivumako, ummoya ovunguzako emaqabungeni, ukukhala kwenkomo ekude — kwakha umvumo othobako. Indawo le ehle khulu beyinikela indawo yokuphumula ekuphithizeleni kwepilo yedorobha, ikhumbuza iimvakatjhi ngokuthula nobulula obutholakala ekwamukeleni kwemvelo.

Esibhedlela sesimanjemanje, abososayensi bezamaphilo basebenza ngokuzikhandla ukutlhogomela iingulani, ukuzinikela kwabo kubonakala kizo zoke iinthombe. Indawo ehlanzekileko beyiyindawo yokwenza izinto, lapho abongikazi nabodorhodere bahlanganisa imithi begodu batjheja amatshwayo aqakathekileko. Ithekhnoloji ethuthukileko yenza bona kube lula ukuhlolisisa nokululama, okufaka hlangana ukuhlangana kwezwelo nokusungula. Iingulani zathola ukududuzeka ngobungcweti nomusa wabasebenzi, zithemba umnqopho wazo wokubuyisela ipilo nokuphila kuhle. Isikhala lesi bekusibonakaliso sokuphikelela komuntu nokuphishekela okuragela phambili kokuphulukisa.

Ihlane belilula ngokungapheliko, indawo ekulu yeendunduma zesihlabathi namathafa anamadwala ngaphasi kwelanga elivuthako. Ama-cacti kanye neentjalo eziqinileko zanamathela ekuphileni endaweni ebudisi, ukujamelana kwazo kukhuthaza ukumangala. Abahambi bakhamba ngendawo ngokutjheja, bazi ubungozi nobuhle obuhlangeneko ehlane. Iimfanekiso bezikhazimula kude, iinkohliso ebezidlala amaqhinga emehlweni kodwana zikhuphule ubumfihlakalo bendawo. Ukutjhinga kwelanga kwatjhugulula ihlane laba likhanvasi elibomvu elivuthako namawolintshi, umbukiso wesikhatjhana wamandla wemvelo nobuhle obuhle khulu.

Indlu ethokomeleko ehlezi hlangana nemithi emide beyinikela indawo yokuphephela ephasini langaphandle. Iindawo zomlilo beziqhaqhazela, zikhipha ukukhanya okufuthumeleko okwahambisana nomhlobiso wendawo. Iimvakatjhi bezihlala zineencwadi nofana zabelana ngeendaba, zithabela ukuthula kwendawo yazo. Ngaphandle, iqhwa lawa ngobumnene, lagubuzela indawo ngombala omhlophe, ngesikhathi ngaphakathi, ukufuthumala nokududuzeka bekubusa. Indawo le eseduze beyihlanganisa ukubuyela emuva ekubeni lula nenduduzo etholakala ekwamukeleni kwemvelo, ukuphunyuka okuhle khulu kokuphumula nokuvuselela.

Ethiyetha yedorobha enomdlandla, abalingisi bazilungiselela ngemva kwesiteji, iinzwa nethabo labo lizwakala. I-orchestra yatjhugulula iinsimbi zayo njengoba ukushaya izandla nokukhuluma kwagcwala ihholo. Lokha ikhetheni naliphakama, isiteji satjhuguluka saba yiphasi ledrama, amahlaya, nofana inhlekelele, ukuthabisa ababukeli begodu kwavusa iimpendulo ezizwakalako. Ubunye bokudlala — abalingisi, abavumi, isiqhema sesiteji — kwakha umsebenzi wobuciko obewukhona ngesikhatjhana kwaphela. Njengombana isigcawu sokugcina siphetha begodu kwaqhuma izandla, umlingo wethiyetha wakhumbuza woke umuntu ngamandla wokucoca iindaba nokuziveza komuntu.

Igceke lesigodlo sezindela elinokuthula bekuyindawo yokucabangisisa nokuthula. Iindela bezikhamba ngokuthula ema-cloisters, zitlhogomela iingadi begodu zilungiselela imithandazo yangelanga. Iphunga lempepho namathuthumbo aqhakazako langezelela ubujamo obungokomoya, lakhuthaza ukucabanga nokuzola. Iimvakatjhi nofana izakhamuzi zathola induduzo ebulula nokuziphatha kwepilo yezindela, lapho ukuzindla nomphakathi kuhlangene khona. Njengombana isekelwe esikweni leminyaka eminengi, indawo ecwengileko le beyinikela indawo engcwele yomphefumulo hlangana nesiphithiphithi sephasi langaphandle.

Endaweni yokwakha ephithizelako, abasebenzi bahlanganisa imizamo yokwakha isakhiwo esitjha, omunye nomunye anikela ngobungcweti bakhe. Ukukhala kwensimbi nokuduma kwemitjhini kutjengise iragelophambili, lokha amaphrothokholi wokuphepha agcina woke umuntu avikelekile. Iinsetjenziswa zafika ngendlela engatjhugulukiko — ikhonkrithi, imigoqo yensimbi, iintina — ingcenye ngayinye eqakathekileko ekuthembekeni kwephrojekthi. Abadwebi bezakhiwo nabonjiniyela gade baphatha umsebenzi, baqinisekisa bona umklamo wenziwa ngokuthembeka. Indawo leyo beyiyibufakazi bezifiso zabantu kanye nomzamo wokubambisana otlhogekako ukutjhugulula amahlelo abe yinto yamambala.

I-coral reef enomdlandla gade igcwele ukuphila ngaphasi kwamanzi ahlanzekileko welwandle. Iinqhema zeenhlambi ezimibalabala zagijima hlangana namagatja wamakhorali, ngesikhathi amafudu welwandle amahle adlula. I-ecosystem eyinkimbinkimbi ye-reef isekela imihlobo eminengi, enye nenye idlala indima eqakathekileko ekugcineni ukulingana. Abatjhayeli be-snorkel nabatshuzi bahlola ipharadesi elingaphasi kwamanzi, bamangazwe buhle nokuhlukahluka kwalo. Ukuvikela iindawo zokuhlala ezibuthakathaka bekuqakathekile ekulondolozeni ukunotha kwepilo yelwandle eenzukulwaneni ezizako.

Ethempelini lamaBuddha elithulileko, iindela zenza amasiko nokuzindla, okwenza umoya wokuthula nokutjheja ngokomoya. Iphunga lempepho beliphephezela emoyeni njengombana ukuvuma bekuzwakala kancani, kukhokela abasebenzi ngaphakathi. Iinthombe nemifanekiso yabonkulunkulu bezinikela iindawo eziqakathekileko zokuthandaza nokucabangisisa, okwenza bona kube nomuzwa wokuthintana nokuhlonipha. Iimvakatjhi ezifuna ukuthula nokuzwisisa zathola ukududuzeka ngokuthula okungapheliko kwethempeli. Iindawo ezinjalo ezicwengileko bezisebenza njengeendawo zokuhlola zangaphakathi nokuhlakulela uzwelo.

Indawo yokutjhayela ephilako beyizele imisebenzi njengombana abatjhayeli beqhwa nabakhwela iqhwa bebakhamba ngeenthambeka ezineqhwa nemizila yeentaba. Iintulo eziphakamisako bezithwala iimvakatjhi ukuya eenqophelweni, zinikela ngemibono ehle khulu yendawo eneqhwa. Ngemva kwelanga lokuzijabulisa, iimvakatjhi zabuthana eendaweni zokuhlala ezihle, zabelana ngeendaba begodu zazifuthumeza ngomlilo ovuthako. Iphunga letjhokoleti etjhisako nokudla okumnandi kwagcwala umoya, kwabangela umjikelezo olandelako wethabo. Indawo yokudlala yasebusika bekumnyanya we-adrenaline, imvelo, nobungani, okwenza iinkhumbuzo ezahlala isikhathi eside ngemva kokuthi iqhwa lincibilike.

Ngaphakathi kwelabhorethri eyinkimbinkimbi, abososayensi benza iinhlahlubo ngokutjheja, bathembele ekuqondeni nobungcweti. Iinsetjenziswa bezikhanya ngaphasi kwamalambu akhanyako njengombana zihlaziya amasampula begodu zirekhoda idatha, zifuna ukuzwisisa ngephasi lemvelo nofana ituthuko yethekhnoloji. Ukusebenzisana nokufuna ukwazi kwadosa umsebenzi wabo, okuvamise ukurholela ekuphumeleleni okungaba nomthelela omuhle emphakathini. Ibhoduluko belihlanganisa ukuhleleka okulawulwako nokuhlola okungapheliko, okufaka hlangana umoya womuntu wokutholwa nokusungula. Imiphumela ngayinye inesandla ekufuneni okukhulu kokuzwisisa nentuthuko.

Isitolo samabhuku esihle esise-Main Street sakhanga abathandi bamabhuku ngobuso baso obukhangako kanye namashelufu azele amavolumu. Abafundi baphequlula amaqoqo akhethwe ngokutjheja, bathola abalobi abatjha kanye namaklasikhi angaphelelwa sikhathi ngokufanako. Iphunga lamaphepha amadala lagubuzela iimvakatjhi, lakhuphula ubumnandi bokuthola iindaba nelwazi. Abasebenzi abanobungani banikela ngeencomo, bangezelela ukuthinta komuntu mathupha esipiliyonini. Indawo le yemitlolo yakhuthaza umphakathi, ukucabanga, nokufunda, kwakhulisa ukuhlobana hlangana kwamagama nalabo abawathandako.

Esivandeni esikhulu seentjalo, iintjalo ezihlaza ezivela ephasini loke bezitjengiswa ngeengcenye ezihlelwe kuhle. Iindlela bezijikajika phakathi kwemibhede yamathuthumbo, amadamu athulileko, kanye nama-arboretum anomthunzi, amema ukuhlola nokuthula. Abalimi bebatlhogomela isitjalo ngasinye ngethando, baqinisekisa ukulondolozwa kwemihlobo engakajayeleki nobuhle bendawo. Iimvakatjhi zamangala ngokuhlukahluka kweentjalo, zifunda ngobudlelwano bemvelo kanye namaqhinga wokutjala iintjalo. Ingadi beyisebenza njengendawo ephephileko yabaziko nabasanda ukufika, umfanekiso ophilako wezinto ezimangalisako zemvelo nobuhlakani babantu.

Iphaga lokuzithabisa eliphilako belinikela ngokuthaba nokupholisa ngama-roller coaster, amasondo we-Ferris, nemidlalo. Amalambu akhanyako nomvumo ojabulisako kwakha umoya onamandla owadosa iinqubuthu ezivela eduze nekude. Abantwana nabantu abadala ngokufanako bahlangabezana neenkhathi zethabo nethabo, babamba iinkhumbuzo hlangana nobumnandi nokungasizi ngalitho. Iindawo ezithengiswako zinikela ngakho koke kusukela kumaswidi wekotoni ukuya ekudleni okunambithekako, okukhuthaza ukuragela phambili nokuzijabulisa. Umbukiso lo wokuzithabisa nokuhleka bewugidinga ubulula nethabo lokuzigedla ngaphandle kokutshwenyeka, ukhumbuza woke umuntu ngethabo elitholakala ekuhlangenwe nakho.

Endlini yeenvakatjhi ethulileko, iinvakatjhi zithokozele ukuphumula ngokuthula emphithiphithini wepilo yelanga nelanga. Ifenitjhara ye-rust kanye nokukhanyisa okufuthumeleko kwakha ubujamo obuhle, lokha ukudla okumnandi kunikela ukuzigedla nokuziphilisa. Indawo ebeyizungezile gade inamasimu namahlathi athulileko, alungele ukukhamba nokuzindla. Ukwamukela komnikazi wendlu yabahambi kwakhuthaza umuzwa wokuba ngowabo nokuphumula, okwenza bona iimvakatjhi zizizwe zisekhaya. Indawo le yokuphephela elula nemvelo yenza bona kube nokuphumula okuvuselelako, ukuhlanganisa abahambi ngejubane elibuthakathaka, elenziwa ngamabomu lepilo yemakhaya.

Imyuziyamu ebuthakathaka, yesimanjemanje itjengisa imibukiso ehlukileko yobukghwari, umlando, nesayensi. Iimvakatjhi zakhamba ngemiboniso ehlelwe kuhle, zisebenzisana nezinto ezisebenzisanako kanye namaphaneli afundisako. Ukwakhiwa ngokwakho bekungumsebenzi wobukghwari, okufaka hlangana umklamo omutjha ukungezelela imibukiso ngaphakathi. Iinhlelo zefundo neminyanya ekhethekileko yakhuthaza ukufuna ukwazi nokufunda. Imyuziyamu beyisebenza njengebhuloho elihlanganisa isikhathi esidlulileko, samanje, nesikhathi esizako, ikhuthaza iimvakatjhi bona zithokozele ubuhlakani babantu nobuhlakani kiyo yoke imikhakha.

Phezu kwentaba ethulileko, i-chapel encani ebegade iqala indawo ezungezeko, i-steeple yayo ifinyelela esibhakabhakeni. Abavakatjhi neemvakatjhi beza ukuzokufumana iduduzo, ukuthandaza, nofana ukuthabela ukubona okuhle. Amaboda wamatje kanye nezangaphakathi ezilula zitjengisa ukuzithoba nokuhlonipha, zikhuthaza isikhathi sokuzindla nokuthintana. Indawo leyo beyisikhumbuzo sokuphishekela kwabantu ukukhula ngokomoya nokuzwisisa. Ekutjhingeni kwelanga, i-chapel yabonakala njengesibani sethemba nokuthula hlangana nobukhulu bemvelo.
